<STRUCT_0001>
Let <MATH_0001> be a surjection of rings with kernel <MATH_0002>. Let us call such
a ring map ``weakly quasi-regular'' if <MATH_0003> is a flat <MATH_0004>-module and
<MATH_0005> is the exterior algebra on <MATH_0006>.
The generalization to ``smooth ring maps'' of what is done in
Lemma <REF_0001> for ``<ACCENT_0001>tale ring maps'' is to look
at flat ring maps <MATH_0007> such that the multiplication map
<MATH_0008> is weakly quasi-regular. For the moment we just stick to
smooth ring maps.
